messages:
Asha CS: FYI - renewal-risk alert looks inflated for the 2025-05 cohort. Quick export shows many accounts with email aliases and missing SSO. s3://cs/exports/may_aliased_sample.csv
Dev Onboard: That explains duplicate outreach. Playbook fires on raw account count.
Riley Data: I ran a tiny cluster: normalize email (lower, strip +tags) then coalesce with sso_id. SQL snippet: 
```sql
select coalesce(sso_id, lower(regexp_replace(email,'\\+.*',''))) as key, count(*) from accounts where created_at >= '2025-05-01' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 20;
```
Riley Data: Proposal: add computed `account_family_id` (md5(key)), count distinct families for healthscore, and set `duplicate_flag=true` on siblings for CS review.
Marta Ops: Ops plan: nightly non-blocking job to populate family id and flag siblings. Exclude flagged rows from playbooks and renewal metrics. We'll add a small review page to confirm high-impact families.
Asha CS: Playbook change request: replace `trial_count_org > 1` with `distinct_account_families > 1` and add a 5-day cooldown after a dedupe tag.
Dev Onboard: I'll open CST ticket and draft PR. ETA PR tomorrow EOD, feature-flag rollout next week. Assigning to @Riley Data and @Marta Ops.
Riley Data: I'll add a Grafana panel `cs.dup_family_rate` and a warn alert at 0.04. Backfill will run for last 3 months.
NotifyBot: Scheduled job nightly-family-dedupe at 2025-07-27T03:00:00Z (job id: ndj-20250727-01) :white_check_mark:
Asha CS: Quick UX ask - a tiny post-signup checkbox "Joining on behalf of an existing teammate?" with optional teammate email to improve precision.
Marta Ops: We'll include survey response in the review ticket payload. Also add a short note in the CS runbook.
Dev Onboard: CST-601 created: "account family dedupe + healthscore update" assigned to Dev Onboard, Riley Data, Marta Ops. Will post PR link when ready. Thanks all :clap:
